paragraphs: He is mentioned once in Ketubot 57b, in a halakhic matter.[^1]

notes.text: פ״א is read as once in this sentence, superseding the old chapter 1 reading. The separated ב introduces Ketubot rather than establishing a chapter number; its spacing is preserved in Hebrew. 57b follows the colon convention, without named-edition verification. The heading title is abbreviated and retained as R'.
